content.comment_body: A few months ago, I acquired a [product_name]. I started with basic testing and network communications. I wanted to try out MODBUS TCP protocol by configuring [product_name] as a server. Although I found some existing MODBUS client programs, I thought it would be useful to create a simple program myself for more convenient testing. Recently, I developed a basic MODBUS TCP client application (in Spanish), which I named "logbus." I hope others can use it for quick tests. The program is made for Windows.
I have also created an Android version of the program, which is currently in Spanish. It would be great if someone could help translate it into other languages.

analysis.insight_summary: The user explains their need for an easy and fast MODBUS TCP client testing method with a [product_name] set as a server. While there are existing MODBUS client tools, they decided to develop a custom application for more flexibility in testing, releasing both Windows and Android versions and expressing interest in multilingual support. No problems with [product_name] itself are mentioned.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants a simple and accessible way to test MODBUS TCP clients with [product_name], looking for tools that are customizable and easy to use for quick testing cycles.
